llms.body:
# OnlineJobs.ph
Hire the best Filipino employees and virtual assistants.

Last updated: 2025-10-10

## Description
OnlineJobs.ph is a marketplace for finding and hiring skilled Filipino virtual assistants and remote employees. Employers can post jobs, browse candidates, and hire directly.

## About
Outsource to the Philippines easily through OnlineJobs.ph — offering direct employer-to-worker connections without expensive agency fees.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.onlinejobs.ph/) - Main entry point.
- [How it works (Employers)](https://www.onlinejobs.ph/how/employer) - Employer workflow and guidance.
- [Pricing](https://www.onlinejobs.ph/pricing) - Plans and pricing details.
- [Real Results](https://www.onlinejobs.ph/real-results) - Success stories and outcomes.
- [Job search (Jobseekers)](https://www.onlinejobs.ph/jobseekers/jobsearch) - Browse available jobs.
- [Post a job (Employers)](https://www.onlinejobs.ph/employers/postjob) - Job posting page.
- [Login](https://www.onlinejobs.ph/login) - Sign in.
- [Register](https://www.onlinejobs.ph/register) - Create an account.
- [Blog](https://www.onlinejobs.ph/blog) - Articles and guides.

## Popular hiring categories
- [Hire Virtual Assistants](https://www.onlinejobs.ph/hire-virtual-assistants) - General VA hiring.
- [Web Development](https://www.onlinejobs.ph/hire/web-development) - Web dev roles.
- [Design / Graphic Design](https://www.onlinejobs.ph/hire/design--graphic-design) - Designers and creatives.
- [CMS / WordPress](https://www.onlinejobs.ph/hire/cms--wordpress) - WordPress specialists.
- [SEO](https://www.onlinejobs.ph/hire/seo) - SEO specialists.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://www.onlinejobs.ph/hire/social-media-marketing) - Social media roles.
- [Web Programming / PHP](https://www.onlinejobs.ph/hire/web-programming--php) - PHP developers.
- [Real Estate](https://www.onlinejobs.ph/hire/real-estate) - Real estate support roles.
- [Content Creation / Article Writing](https://www.onlinejobs.ph/hire/content-creation--article-writing) - Writers and content creators.
- [E-commerce / Amazon](https://www.onlinejobs.ph/hire/e-commerce--amazon) - E-commerce roles.
- [Marketing](https://www.onlinejobs.ph/hire/marketing) - Marketing roles.

## Notes for AI crawlers
- OnlineJobs.ph connects businesses with remote Filipino professionals across many industries.
- Employers can post jobs, browse candidate profiles, and hire directly.
- Job seekers create profiles, showcase skills, and apply for online jobs.
- Platform features may include ID proofing, skill tests, and direct messaging.

## Contact
- [Contact page](https://www.onlinejobs.ph/contact)

## Organization
- Owner: OnlineJobs.ph Team
- Location: Philippines
- Language: English

The Job Board to Connect You with "Virtual Assistants" from the Philippines

We’re the #1 marketplace for hiring Filipino remote talent. Find, recruit, and build your offshore team yourself. No middlemen, no extra fees, no salary markups, no hassle.

Looking for Talent?

Looking for Work?

More than Virtual Assistants from the Philippines

Let’s be honest—you probably want more than just a "virtual assistant."

You want more than someone to hold your hand while you run your business; you’re looking for someone skilled, reliable, and great at what they do. You need professionals who can create. Engage. Develop. Manage. Design. Innovate.

Filipinos are so much more than capable virtual assistants. You're not just looking for a skilled worker who speaks English—you're also looking for a contractor with the dedication, resilience, and loyalty to make your business thrive.

So yeah, it’s more than just hiring a VA; it’s access to a huge talent pool so you can build a remote team of talented, diligent, and dependable specialists.

How it Works

Search the database of 5,000,000+ Filipino profiles. See what skills exist. Find highly educated and highly talented people. Then, post a job and let people apply, or contact them directly from their profile and see if they're interested in working for you.

1

Post a Job

Post a job quickly and easily and let talent come to you.

2

We tell you who to hire - AI Matching

Our advanced AI algorithms cut down your time to hire by telling you who is most likely to succeed at your role and who you should interview first. You still control the hiring process, you just hire smarter and better the first time.

3

Message and Interview your way

Use our platform. Use your email. Video interview. Chat. Whatever works for your personal style. We don't pigeonhole you into a specific system.

4

Hire

We're not an agency. We don't pick the people for you. You hire direct. No middleman. No fees. No salary markups. We don't stand in your way of working with your staff. We just make it easy for you to connect with great people.

AI Ready. AI Intelligent

Filipino VAs are using AI every day to improve businesses.

Is AI replacing humans? Yes.
Are VAs going away? No.

More people are hiring from the Philippines now than ever before. And the VAs are more effective than ever before because of AI.

They're using AI to improve your business.

They're developing AI processes, AI agents, AI chatbots, and AI integrations for you. They're using AI to streamline, create, verify, organize...

The world is changing. Hire help to keep up with the change.

Trusted by 600,000+ small and large businesses

Virtual assistants aren’t just for big companies. Most of our customers are small businesses and entrepreneurs hiring their first or second or 10th team member.

What kind of jobs are Filipinos good at?

With a population of 100,000,000+ (yes, over one hundred million people), the Philippines has people with every skill set imaginable. Some of the most common hires are Virtual assistants, Graphic Designers, Social media marketing, SEO, Content writing, AI, Customer Support, E-Commerce with Amazon and Shopify, and Telemarketers.

View profiles and resumes of other common roles:

Virtual AssistantAmazon ExpertFacebook Ads ManagerCopywriterWordpress DeveloperSales RepresentativeLead GenerationQuickbooksSEOMarketing SpecialistEmail MarketerPPCGraphic DesignerShopify DevelopereBay Virtual AssistantEcommerceSocial Media MarketerVideo EditorCustomer ServiceResearcherPHP DeveloperData EntryGoogle Ads ManagerAccountantReal Estate Virtual AssistantWeb DeveloperiOS DeveloperContent WriterProject ManagerWeb DesignerAIGoHighLevel
Search more TalentSearch more Talent

See how a VA can serve your business.

Hire Full-time, Part-time, Per project - Hire your way

At OnlineJobs we allow you to work with people however suits you. You’ll find Filipino talent looking for all different types of work including full-time, part-time, per project, hourly, salaried, or however you want to hire.

We’re not an agency. We’re just a platform

- No contracts

- No long term (or short term) commitments

- No term limits

- No requirements

We built OnlineJobs.ph to be what we wanted to find.
A job board that let us find the people we wanted.

Without someone giving us a mediocre hire.

Without paying salary markups.

Without having someone stand in between us and our staff.

Without forcing our "virtual assistants" (they’re really Online Filipino Specialists) to commute.

Without having them lose 10-20% of their wages to a job board. Or losing 60-80% to an agency.

Our goal is to provide the best VA hiring experience.

We’ve Accomplished ItWe’ve Accomplished ItWe’ve Accomplished It

Why JUST the Philippines?

It’s the cultural differences that make you more likely to find someone great in the Philippines than anywhere else in the world.

Filipinos are generally:

Honest
Loyal
Hardworking
Speak Western English
Pleasing
Problem solvers
Highly educated

You’re unlikely to have communication problems with your VAs.

English is one of two official languages of the Philippines.

You can find good people anywhere in the world. But the Philippines increases your chances.
